Rude service and ridiculous rules – not welcoming at all
Apr 2026 • Family
We were really looking forward to visiting Papaya, but were turned away immediately at the door in a very rude and dismissive way.

It was over 30 degrees outside, yet they refused entry simply because some of the men in our group were wearing smart shorts. On top of that, they wouldn't allow one person under 18, despite our group consisting of 7 people ranging in age from 14 to 75 – clearly a family outing.

The attitude from the staff was unwelcoming from the second we walked up. It was obvious within seconds that we didn't fit their "ideal" customer profile. Instead of explaining policies politely, they just turned us away instantly with zero flexibility or hospitality.

It’s a shame when places act so elitist and exclusive, especially when the weather is so hot that long trousers are completely impractical. We won’t be going back and certainly wouldn't recommend it to families or anyone looking for a relaxed vibe.

Papaya is a must-visit if you’re in Saigon!
Dec 2024 • Friends
Papaya Restaurant in Saigon exceeded all my expectations and quickly became one of my favorite dining experiences in Vietnam. From the moment I walked in, the cozy and welcoming ambiance set the tone for an incredible meal.

The menu offers a delightful mix of traditional Vietnamese flavors with a modern twist. Every dish I tried was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with authentic taste. The portions were generous, and the use of fresh, local ingredients was evident in every bite.

The service was equally impressive. The staff were warm, attentive, and happy to offer recommendations, which truly enhanced the overall experience. Their knowledge of the menu and enthusiasm for Vietnamese cuisine made me feel like I was dining among friends.

The atmosphere of Papaya is intimate yet lively, making it an ideal spot for both a relaxed meal and a special occasion. Despite its high quality, the prices were very reasonable, offering exceptional value for money.

If you're in Saigon and looking for a restaurant that captures the heart and soul of Vietnamese cuisine while offering a memorable dining experience, Papaya is an absolute must-visit. I can't wait to return!
